At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.

Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H4945-4947)

dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts the Government of Burma and international financial institution officials involved in lending decisions.
dimensions.evidence: continue the pause by the Bank on disbursements and the making of new financing commitments to the Government of Burma

dimensions.assessment: Maintains a suspension of development financing and loan disbursements for a national government.
dimensions.evidence: continue the pause on disbursements and new financing commitments to the Government of Burma

dimensions.assessment: The source states no direct U.S. federal spending or revenue changes, though it concerns international bank disbursements involving Burma.
Directs the voting stance of a single U.S. executive director at an international financial institution.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of the Treasury shall direct the United States Executive Director at the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development to use the voice and vote of the United States

dimensions.assessment: Continues an existing policy initiated in 2021 without a specified end date, dependent on national interest determinations.
dimensions.evidence: that was initiated after a military coup overthrew the democratically elected Government of Burma in 2021

missing_information: Specific dollar amounts of affected financing commitments
Exact timeline for the continuation of the pause
importance_detail.rationale: This bill directs the U.S. Executive Director at the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development to continue a pause on disbursements and new financing to Burma, barring a national interest determination by the Treasury Secretary.
